headline: First BanCorp Net Income Holds Flat as Loan Expansion Offsets Deposit Costs
summary: First BanCorp reported flat net income for the third quarter as asset growth and expense discipline balanced higher deposit funding costs.
why: First BanCorp operates extensively in Puerto Rico and Florida, reflecting regional credit growth and funding cost dynamics.

impacts.name: First BanCorp
impacts.why: Higher loan volumes offset deposit cost inflation to keep bottom-line net income stable.
